mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.administrator, c.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.signature, u.created_at AS createdAt FROM app_user u JOIN auth_local_credential c ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_local_credential (username, password_hash, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{userId}, #{now})
